data.explanation: Fact A reports cumulative shipments as of December 31, 2021, while Fact B reports cumulative shipments as of March 31, 2024. The difference in the total number of shipments is explained by the additional two and a quarter years of operational activity included in the later report.
data.reconciliation: The figures are consistent because they represent cumulative totals measured at different points in time, with the 2024 figure naturally being higher due to the additional period of business operations.
